answer.description: The agent's final text answer. Empty when the agent finished without a message.

conversation_id.description: The conversation the message was added to: the one requested, or the one created for it.

message.description: The explanation the agent received in place of the prompt.

tool_id.description: The tool whose call was declined.

declined_prompts.description: The prompts that the endpoint declined. In an interactive conversation, these prompts pause the agent until the user answers. Examples are tool confirmations, questions to the user, and destructive API approvals. This endpoint has no user, so it declines each prompt and tells the agent why. The property is absent if the agent raised no prompts.
